note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described in the original; the worker is dimorphic, both forms being combined in a single section; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brown to reddish brown, rostrum paler than the head; antennae straw yellow to pale brown; thorax pale brown to brown; abdominal tergites dark brown, almost black; sternites straw yellow. Head without long setae, only one short seta on each side of the vertex and one on each side of the base of the rostrum; thorax and abdominal tergites without long setae; sternites densely setose. Body length 4.50–4.90 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae (1.80–1.90 mm including the rostrum, 1.20–1.30 mm excluding the rostrum, maximum width 1.20–1.30 mm, width at the constriction 0.80–0.90 mm; head constriction index, i.e. width at the constriction/maximum width, 0.66–0.72); posterior part strongly raised (posterior bulge 0.40–0.60 mm; head bulge index, i.e. posterior bulge/head length without rostrum, 0.33–0.48); in lateral view strongly incurved behind the base of the rostrum, occiput strongly raised. Eyes situated behind the antennae, white, suboval, indistinct. Rostrum short, conical, about half the head length (0.60–0.65 mm long; rostrum length/head length without rostrum index 0.46–0.50); apex strongly raised in lateral view, with a few setae; without rostral swelling. Antennae rather long, 14-segmented; 3rd segment 2 times to slightly more than 2 times the length of the 2nd, slightly longer than the 4th. Mandibles reduced; each with a long, pointed spine-like process. Thorax with a fine white median longitudinal line. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin convex, without notch; posterior margin strongly convex, without notch; deep lateral notches at the junction of the anterior and posterior lobes; 0.35 mm long, 0.70 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule brown, paler anteriorly; antennae, thorax and femora pale brown; abdominal tergites blackish brown with a smoky tinge, sternites white. Dorsum glabrous, venter with many long setae. Body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subsquare, widest at the mandibular base (maximum width 1.35 mm); frontal suture distinct. Frontal plate elongate, translucent white. Antennae 15-segmented, slender; 3rd segment much larger than the 2nd or the 4th. Postclypeus brown, inflated, length less than half its width (0.20 mm long, 0.75 mm wide). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a shallow median notch, otherwise as in the soldier (0.52 mm long, 0.73 mm wide). Minor worker: apart from the shorter antennal segments, the 3rd segment equal in length to the 2nd, and the anterolateral corners of the pronotum very weakly concave or not concave, as in the major worker.
